name: Amulet
text: A pendant on a chain, worn close to the heart.

name: Bracer
text: A rigid band of metal worn about the forearm.

name: Ring
text: A band of metal sized for a finger.

name: Bracelet
text: A slender band worn about the wrist.

name: Mark
text: A token of office or allegiance pinned to the clothing.

name: Torc
text: A rigid neck ring of twisted metal, prized among the Reachmen.

name: Cloth Amulet
text: A small charm of stitched cloth on a cord.

name: Wand
text: A slim rod of wood or bone, carved to carry a charge.
